name: Postgres + Better Auth or Clerk
summary: Your own stack: any Postgres (Neon, Vercel Postgres, Railway, your own) with Drizzle, and Better Auth or Clerk for sign-in. Access is checked in server code.
bestFor: Developers who want to own the database and choose each piece, or who already run Next.js with Neon.
cost: Neon has a free tier; Better Auth is free and open source; Clerk is free for small user counts.
